dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: No wonder I had a nagging feeling that I should come over and have a look... Well met, "Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini."

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Let me guess. You're here for the Flower-Feather Clan's warrior trial?

choices.text: That's right. I'm here to certify its difficulty!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: You won't be disappointed, then. I've got nothing but the highest standards for Qucusaur Riders.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Teaching's not my strong suit, so when I was invited to design these stages, I went with "recalling tough challenges and piling them in one after the other."

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: The result was... a ninety-nine percent failure rate on the part of our tribe's warriors — on the first stage, no less. As a result... There wasn't any choice but to take Irade's advice and tune the difficulty down a notch.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: But I doubt that even the trials as they originally stood would have truly stretched you. If we wanted that... We'd have to go with situations even I would prove helpless in.

choices.text: Thanks for the kind words, but I don't need special treatment!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: No, I do believe you worthy of such respect. I'm no teacher, but I've never misjudged the strength of those I meet.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: And as far as yours is concerned... only the most trying of challenges would befit you.

choices.text: I need to consider the stages' suitability for ordinary warriors, though...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: ...Fair enough. You've got a task to complete, and we'll have more opportunities in the future.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: One day, I'll lay out a banquet table of battle that "transcends" the pinnacle of Qucusaur Rider ability, just for you.

choices.text: The universality of the stages is not to be overlooked either!
Haha, don't put me on a pedestal, now!
I could've come for you, for all you know.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: So you wanna "transcend" my record, then? That's just my speed. I'll have you know that I started by stuffing these stages full of tough challenges that I've faced in the past.
